examples.explanation: Multiply each left row by the right column.
A plain list can be the left operand.

test_matmul.title: test_matmul
test_matmul.code:
def test_matmul():
    result = Matrix(A) @ Matrix(B)
    assert isinstance(result, Matrix)
    assert result.values == AB

test_matmul_does_not_change_operands.title: test_matmul_does_not_change_operands
test_matmul_does_not_change_operands.code:
def test_matmul_does_not_change_operands():
    a, b = Matrix([row[:] for row in A]), Matrix([row[:] for row in B])
    a @ b
    assert a.values == A
    assert b.values == B

test_rmatmul.title: test_rmatmul
test_rmatmul.code:
def test_rmatmul():
    """A plain list of lists on the left uses Matrix.__rmatmul__."""
    result = A @ Matrix(B)
    assert isinstance(result, Matrix)
    assert result.values == AB

test_imatmul.title: test_imatmul
test_imatmul.code:
def test_imatmul():
    a = Matrix([row[:] for row in A])
    original = a
    a @= Matrix(B)
    assert a is original
    assert a.values == AB

test_non_square.title: test_non_square
test_non_square.code:
def test_non_square():
    left = Matrix([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])
    right = Matrix([[7, 8], [9, 10], [11, 12]])
    assert (left @ right).values == [[58, 64], [139, 154]]
    assert (right @ left).values == [[39, 54, 69], [49, 68, 87], [59, 82, 105]]

test_identity_and_vector.title: test_identity_and_vector
test_identity_and_vector.code:
def test_identity_and_vector():
    identity = Matrix([[1, 0], [0, 1]])
    assert (Matrix(A) @ identity).values == A
    assert (Matrix(A) @ Matrix([[1], [1]])).values == [[3], [7]]

test_repr.title: test_repr
test_repr.code:
def test_repr():
    assert repr(Matrix(A) @ Matrix(B)) == '<Matrix values="[[37, 40], [85, 92]]">'

test_inplace_square_uses_original_values.title: test_inplace_square_uses_original_values
test_inplace_square_uses_original_values.code:
def test_inplace_square_uses_original_values():
    matrix = Matrix([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
    alias = matrix
    matrix @= matrix
    assert matrix is alias
    assert matrix.values == [[7, 10], [15, 22]]

test_product_storage_is_independent.title: test_product_storage_is_independent
test_product_storage_is_independent.code:
def test_product_storage_is_independent():
    left, right = Matrix([[1, 2]]), Matrix([[3, 4], [5, 6]])
    result = left @ right
    result.values[0][0] = 100
    assert left.values == [[1, 2]]
    assert right.values == [[3, 4], [5, 6]]

test_inplace_preserves_distinct_right_op.title: test_inplace_preserves_distinct_right_operand
test_inplace_preserves_distinct_right_op.code:
def test_inplace_preserves_distinct_right_operand():
    left, right = Matrix([[1, 2]]), Matrix([[3], [4]])
    left @= right
    assert left.values == [[11]]
    assert right.values == [[3], [4]]
